title: A cast right after the pickaxe and the hoe
about: Farm pond bank, facing the water, day 4 at 10:00, the rod selected. Owner bug: the farmer cast with the rod's wind-up frozen behind the fishing sheet (raised like a pickaxe) and a swing frame with the pickaxe's swoosh. Press Action: the cast plays (rod only), the sheet opens over the farmer holding the line out, and a catch reels in. Check every facing (the e2e block fishCast stands on a bank for each) and a cast straight after a hoe swing and after a pickaxe swing (it gives the pickaxe).
